explanation: Pack each line greedily, then distribute its required padding cyclically across the gaps, favoring earlier gaps. Join the final line with single spaces and right-pad it. This reference’s Join repeatedly concatenates prefix strings.
timeComplexity: O(S + nL) safe upper bound for total source characters S, n words and line width L, including repeated concatenation.
spaceComplexity: O(L) current-line workspace, plus formatted output.
